desc: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015 in relation to allotment of 181480352 Series I Preference Shares and 136110264 Series II Preference Shares as Bonus pursuant to Scheme of Arrangement at meeting held on August 25, 2026
Intimation of Investor Meet to be held on 03rd September, 2026

With reference to the captioned matter, intimating the schedule of 56th AGM of the Company and in compliance with Regulation 34(1) of SEBI Regulations 2015 for the FY 2025-2026, please find enclosed Integrated Annual Report of the Company for the FY 2025-26.The aforesaid documents are being dispatched electronically to all the Members whose e-mail addresses are registered with the Company/the Registrar & Share Transfer Agent/ Depository  Participant(s).  Further, in compliance with Regulation 36(1)(b) of the Listing Regulations, a physical communication is being sent to Members whose e-mail ids are not registered with the Company/the Registrar & Share Transfer Agent/the Depository Participant(s) providing the weblink where the Integrated Annual Report for the FY 2025-26 and the Notice of the 56th Annual General Meeting can be accessed on the Company's website.The PDF version of the above-mentioned document is available on the website of Company at https://www.subhashsilkmills.com.

With reference to the captioned matter, we hereby inform you that the 56th Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the Members of Subhash Silk Mills Ltd. will be held on Thursday, 24th September, 2026 at IST 10:00 a.m. through Video Conferencing ("VC") / Other Audio Visual Means ("OAVM"), in accordance, with the relevant circulars issued by Ministry of Corporate Affairs and Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). Please find enclosed herewith Notice of the 56th Annual General Meeting of the Company. The 56th Annual Report is uploaded on Company''s website at https://www.subhashsilkmills.com/. Please take the same on your record.
